profile.summary:
How does FixingPhotos.com photo restoration service works? Simply scan the damaged image and email it to us photorepairwizards@gmail.com … if you need us to scan the damaged photo for any reason, please mail us the photo and we will scan it for you free of charge. Once we receive the image we can better determine what needs to be done and how much it will cost you to fix it. Estimates are good for 30 days. Want to learn more? Then please visit https://www.fixingphotos.com

 Established in 2003, Fixing Photos  http://www.fixingphotos.com/ specializes in affordable photo restoration and repair. Using state-of-the-art photo repair and enhancement programs, old and/or damaged photographs can easily be restored to, or near, their original condition.

Specialties: Well trained in the use of high-tech image/photo programs: such as PhotoShop 7, Photo Impact 7. Such programs, if used correctly, can work wonders on worn out photos, and create spectacular image effects.

Proficient in Html, CSS, SEO, Javascript programming. Well versed in Photoshop Cs2 9.0, FlashMxProfessional 7.0, and Dreamweaver MX 2005
